title: dactylorhiza kerryensis
intro: Dactylorhiza kerryensis, commonly known as Kerry Marsh Orchid, is a terrestrial orchid species native to Ireland. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza kerryensis include its ability to relax the digestive system and ease inflammation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
